'''Romex''' was a type of fabric, used for making clothing. [[Trever Flume]] attempted to get [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to buy some romex, to replace Obi-Wan's [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]], but was rejected.
